description: Na₂SrAl₄(B₂O₇)₂ crystallizes in the trigonal P3 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.42 Å) and three longer (2.94 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six AlO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.31 Å) and three longer (2.85 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Sr is bonded to six O atoms to form SrO₆ octahedra that share corners with six AlO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.52 Å) and three longer (2.65 Å) Sr-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent Al sites. In the first Al site, Al is bonded to four O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent SrO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one AlO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 66°. There is one shorter (1.67 Å) and three longer (1.80 Å) Al-O bond lengths. In the second Al site, Al is bonded to four O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one AlO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 69°. There is one shorter (1.75 Å) and three longer (1.77 Å) Al-O bond lengths. In the third Al site, Al is bonded to four O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent SrO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one AlO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 65°. There is one shorter (1.71 Å) and three longer (1.79 Å) Al-O bond lengths. In the fourth Al site, Al is bonded to four O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one AlO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 68°. There is one shorter (1.73 Å) and three longer (1.77 Å) Al-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All B-O bond lengths are 1.39 Å. In the second B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All B-O bond lengths are 1.38 Å. In the third B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All B-O bond lengths are 1.38 Å. In the fourth B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All B-O bond lengths are 1.39 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to three equivalent Na and two Al atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two Al atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Al, and one B atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Sr, one Al, and one B atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Al, and one B atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Sr, one Al, and one B atom.
